integrity: The proof classifies all lattice differences relevant below the covering threshold, integrates the unique positive-volume pair lens exactly, and uses the absence of positive-volume triple intersections to obtain an exact inclusion-exclusion formula. The endpoint covering radius and optimal density are taken from the cited primary source; all new multiplicity formulas are independently derived. The embedded exact-arithmetic checker is supplementary and is not used as a substitute for the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The result fixes the Lian--Xue body-centered cubic lattice and varies only the common octahedral scale through the first covering threshold. It does not treat arbitrary lattice perturbations, uniqueness of optimal lattices, or the higher-overlap regime beyond the covering radius. A differently phrased or unindexed historical computation of the same periodic union profile remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact subcritical coverage profile of the optimal octahedral lattice
